summary: Verified telecaller Data/Leads filters (Status + Call Outcome), search bar, and WhatsApp URL generation with 91 country code prefix. Backend: 15/15 pytest tests pass (default list, search by name, search by phone, filter by 4 statuses, filter by 7 call outcomes, and combined filter). Frontend: Data page shows both Status filter row (All, Not Interested, Follow Up, Lead, File) AND Call Outcome filter row (All, Connected, No Answer, Switched Off, Not Connecting, Busy, Wrong Number, Voicemail). Search input filters results (via ?search= query param hitting name/phone/email regex). WhatsApp button on Lead Detail opened URL 'https://wa.me/919876543210?text=...' confirming 91 prefix is prepended. Float-phone handling logic ('9876543210.0' -> '919876543210') verified in JS.
critical_code_review_comments: getWhatsAppLink in LeadDetail.js correctly handles float phones (splits on '.') and prepends 91 when length==10; identical logic should exist in any admin-side lead detail if present (only telecaller flow verified).
Backend GET /api/leads accepts last_call_outcome query param and correctly filters — matches frontend outcomeFilter state key.

Search uses case-insensitive $regex on name/phone/email which works but is not indexed — could be slow at scale; consider text index or normalizing phone (strip decimals) before storage to make phone search reliable for float-formatted numbers imported from Excel.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Telecaller has 2 seed leads (Test Customer, Test Lead) both with phone 9876543210 and status follow_up. Backend last_call_outcome query param works. WhatsApp URL prefix verified via captured window.open URL.
